phase.title: Phase

program.title: Program
program.text: Edit the current one or create a new one, keeping the exercise ids.

diet.title: Diet
diet.text: Seven separate days, quantities and brands only.

rules.title: How it works
rules.logs: Logs stay as they are: only profile, programs, diet and history are updated.
rules.archive: Every replaced version goes to Plan → Archive.
rules.newId: A new program or diet gets a new id; the previous one gets an end date and stays among the previous ones.
rules.exerciseIds: Exercise ids keep the strength charts: same exercise, same id.

profile.title: Profile and macros
profile.lead: Empty fields keep the current values.
profile.rulesHint: They drive the advice in the weekly check.

program.title: Program
program.closePrev: End “{{name}}” the day before the start

diet.title: Diet
diet.closePrev: End “{{name}}” the day before the start
diet.ticksHint: Ticks are tied to the position of meals and foods: add at the end and avoid reordering without a reason.

history.title: History entry
history.lead: Shows up in the Plan's timeline. Recommended for every change.

issues.macroMismatch: The macros add up to {{calc}} kcal, the target is {{kcal}}.
issues.profileEmpty: The profile is included but has no values.
issues.idFormat: The id “{{id}}” should only have letters, numbers and dashes.
issues.programIdTaken: A program with id “{{id}}” already exists: a new program needs a new id.
issues.noSessions: At least one session is needed.
issues.sessionIdTwice: the id “{{id}}” is already used by another session.
issues.exerciseIdTwice: the id “{{id}}” is already used in this session.
issues.exerciseRenamed: the id “{{id}}” was “{{was}}” until now. That is fine only if it is the same exercise.
issues.badSets: the number of sets is not valid.
issues.manySets: {{n}} sets: the preference is {{max}} at most.
issues.repsOrder: the minimum reps are above the maximum.
issues.supersetLast: is in a superset but has no exercise after it.
issues.supersetRest: the first exercise of a superset usually has 0 rest: the rest goes on the second.
issues.weekUnknown: {{day}}: “{{id}}” is not a session of this program.
issues.sessionUnplanned: The session “{{id}}” is not on any day of the week.
issues.programNotActive: The program is not active: the app will keep using the current one.
issues.dietIdTaken: A diet with id “{{id}}” already exists: a new diet needs a new id.
issues.dietVsProfile: The diet's kcal ({{diet}}) differ from the profile's ({{profile}}).
issues.dayCount: {{n}} days: the rule is seven separate days.
issues.dietWeekUnknown: {{day}} points to the day “{{id}}”, which does not exist.
issues.dietNotActive: The diet is not active: the app will keep using the current one.
issues.historyNoDate: The history entry has no date.
issues.historyNoTitle: The history entry has no title.
issues.historySuggested: No history entry: add one to find this change in the timeline.
issues.nothingIncluded: Pick at least one section to include.

review.title: Summary
review.applyLead: Updates the diary on this phone right away. Replaced versions go to the Archive.
review.confirmText: Profile, programs, diet and history are updated; logs stay as they are. You can always find the previous version in Plan → Archive.
review.noApplyFile: You are working on a loaded file: download the result and import it in the app with “Load plan, programs and diet only”.
review.noApplyEmpty: The diary is empty here. Opening this page from the app lets you apply directly; otherwise download the file and import it.
review.fixFirst: Fix the items in red first.
review.done: Updated: {{parts}}. The previous versions are in Plan → Archive.
review.fileLead: To keep it or send it to Claude. Import it with “Load plan, programs and diet only”.
review.copyFailed: Couldn't copy: the text is selected in the preview, copy it from the menu.
